paths.description: MSN homepage and consent entry state, representing the primary personalised-news feed and search entry point.
News section listing, representing a category/listing archetype.
Weather application, representing MSN’s data-rich interactive tool at a narrow viewport.
Deliberately invalid route, representing HTTP/navigation recovery.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion still animates the consent surface
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, objective-probe.json reports a 250 ms slideInFromBottom animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential consent entrance animation in the reduce media query.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not expose View Transition styling
findings.evidence: The captured page CSS contains no view-transition declarations; navigation is presented as abrupt state replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for major route/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Scroll-linked experience does not use declarative scroll timelines
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS capture contains no animation-timeline declaration despite a long feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS scroll-driven animations for any scroll-linked feedback instead of main-thread listeners.

findings.summary: Feed gestures lack declarative snap or overscroll affordances
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS capture contains no scroll-snap declaration on the long feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use platform scrolling, scroll snap, and overscroll behavior for carousel/feed gestures.

findings.summary: Long feeds provide no captured scroll-state-aware progress cue
findings.evidence: Desktop/mobile captures show a long feed but no progress indicator, and CSS has no scroll-state query.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight declarative scroll-state or progress feedback to persistent chrome.

findings.summary: Overlay positioning is manual rather than anchor-positioned
findings.evidence: Captured CSS has no anchor-name/position-anchor declarations; consent and menus use fixed/absolute positioning.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning with position fallbacks for transient attached UI.

findings.summary: Consent interruption obscures the primary content on first load
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a consent surface covering or dimming the personalised-news feed before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise the consent interruption, keep equal reject/accept choices, and avoid obscuring more content than legally necessary.

findings.summary: Consent overlay is not a native dialog
findings.evidence: Recon finds role=dialog but objective probe finds zero native dialog/popover elements; dismissal is custom-scripted.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog for modal consent and declarative controls/focus management.

findings.summary: Advertising and navigation chrome compete with content
findings.evidence: The first desktop viewport devotes substantial space to shortcut icons, navigation, a sponsored slot, and consent chrome before feed content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce non-content chrome and reserve prominent space for editorial content.

findings.summary: Weather page forces a desktop-sized layout on mobile
findings.evidence: weather-layout.json reports inner/scroll width 621 px against a 360 px visual viewport, 261 px horizontal overflow; the screenshot clips weather text and controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a true 360 px layout viewport, intrinsic sizing, and reflowing weather panels.

findings.summary: Components do not reliably adapt to their container
findings.evidence: The weather component remains 621 px wide at a 360 px visual viewport; captured homepage CSS contains no @container rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container queries and intrinsic sizing for reused feed/weather modules.

findings.summary: Invalid routes fail as a blank screen
findings.evidence: The invalid-route screenshot is an unlabelled blank dark page with no 404 explanation, back link, search, or retry.
findings.suggestedFix: Render an explicit not-found state with search, home navigation, and recovery actions.

findings.summary: Core Web Vitals and load responsiveness miss the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports LCP 10.0 s, CLS 0.102 and TBT 520 ms; the separate trace reports LCP 3.31 s and 1.19 s blocking, confirming variable but poor load behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, reduce blocking script, and reserve late content space.

findings.summary: Measured layout shift exceeds the good CLS threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.102, just outside the good <=0.1 range.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve stable dimensions for ads/feed modules and preserve font metrics.

findings.summary: Long JavaScript tasks block interaction
findings.evidence: Trace reports 6 long tasks, a 1021.94 ms longest task and 1190.48 ms total blocking; Lighthouse TBT is 520 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Split, defer, and prioritise script work; move non-UI processing off the main thread.

findings.summary: Network delivery is heavy and script-dominated
findings.evidence: HAR summary records 294 requests and 4,499,311 transferred bytes, including 96 scripts / 2,331,227 bytes and parser-inserted high-priority candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce critical chains, defer non-critical bundles, and tighten caching.

findings.summary: Large script and third-party payload dominates load
findings.evidence: HAR records 96 scripts and 2.33 MB transferred script, led by a 370 KB common bundle plus ads/auth/telemetry bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage analysis to remove duplicate/unused code and conditionally load ads/auth features.

findings.summary: Advertisement label misses minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 4.21:1 for #777 text on #111, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase the advertisement-label contrast to at least 4.5:1.

findings.summary: Mobile reflow fails on the weather tool
findings.evidence: At 360 px, weather has 261 px horizontal overflow even though the homepage target-size audit passes.
findings.suggestedFix: Make every weather panel reflow at 320–360 px and verify zoomed layouts.

findings.summary: Some feed images are served below device-density requirements
findings.evidence: Lighthouse image-size-responsive audit fails: a 380x199 image is displayed at 380x199 where 570x299 is expected for DPR.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve DPR-appropriate responsive image candidates with srcset/sizes.

findings.summary: The homepage is ineligible for back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports four BFCache failure reasons, including an unload handler and no-store behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload handlers and avoid unnecessary no-store responses/cookie mutations on navigation.

findings.summary: Rendered homepage has no canonical URL
findings.evidence: Objective probe finds no link[rel=canonical] despite index,follow; public localized routes should state canonical/hreflang relationships.
findings.suggestedFix: Add canonical and appropriate hreflang links consistent with sitemap and robots policy.

findings.summary: Cookie and CSP posture weakens otherwise secure transport
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff, but CSP allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; cookies audit flags multiple non-Secure cookies including MUIDB and _C_Auth.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate unsafe CSP sources and mark every HTTPS cookie Secure with the narrowest SameSite policy.

findings.summary: Anonymous load has an extensive tracking and third-party footprint
findings.evidence: Tracker capture finds 24 third-party origins and DoubleClick; HAR assigns 290/294 requests and 4.47 MB to other origins, including telemetry/ad endpoints.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise pre-consent third parties, batch telemetry, and load advertising only after the applicable consent state.

findings.summary: Defensive policy coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers lack Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; CSP permits unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval; Lighthouse finds 11 third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Set strict Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, harden CSP, and remove third-party-cookie dependencies.

findings.summary: Core content is a JavaScript-only shell
findings.evidence: Discoverability capture gets HTTP 200 but 0% raw/rendered word coverage, empty #root, and no raw title, H1, or description; crawler screenshot is blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core headlines, links and metadata, then hydrate enhancements.

findings.summary: Runtime layout and navigation states are brittle
findings.evidence: Weather overflows by 261 px on mobile and an invalid route renders blank, showing failure to stabilise key runtime states.
findings.suggestedFix: Constrain responsive modules and provide robust route/error boundaries.

findings.summary: Failure routes offer no recovery
findings.evidence: The representative invalid URL renders a blank page without status, explanation or action.
findings.suggestedFix: Add explicit 404/network error UI with retry, search, and return-home actions.

findings.summary: Localized page still relies heavily on physical positioning
findings.evidence: The page correctly sets lang=en-gb and dir=ltr, but captured CSS repeatedly uses left/right/padding-left instead of logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace physical directional properties with inline/block logical equivalents where layout direction matters.

findings.summary: Feed media delivery is not consistently resolution-appropriate
findings.evidence: HAR transfers 1.59 MB of images and Lighthouse flags under-resolution responsive images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate modern, DPR-appropriate responsive image variants and tune quality by display size.

findings.summary: Load performs substantial non-content work
findings.evidence: The page makes 294 requests and executes six trace long tasks while contacting telemetry, advertising and auth services on anonymous load.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritise background work and conditionally load non-essential dependencies after user need/consent.

findings.summary: Third-party cost is disproportionate on first load
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 290 requests and 4,468,134 bytes to other origins; trackers finds 24 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget and defer/remove advertising, telemetry, auth and assessor scripts that do not serve the first task.

findings.summary: Agent and non-JS clients cannot access structured core content
findings.evidence: Discoverability reports a 0% raw-content coverage JS shell, and no structured agent capability is exposed in the tested public surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render semantic content and expose safe structured search/content tools where useful.

findings.summary: Repeated feed traversal shows large retained growth and needs leak investigation
findings.evidence: Separate-session heap summaries grew from 1,362,220 nodes / 78.9 MB baseline to 2,994,283 nodes / 173.4 MB after ten bottom/top traversals. Session variance prevents a definitive leak attribution, but the 2.2x growth is material.
findings.suggestedFix: Reproduce in one controlled session with baseline/target/final snapshots, then fix retained feed cards, listeners, observers or caches.

findings.summary: Homepage memory footprint is very large
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 1,362,220 nodes and 78.9 MB self size; post-scroll reaches 2,994,283 nodes and 173.4 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualise feed content, bound caches, and unload offscreen modules.

findings.summary: Heap growth indicates unbounded retained state risk
findings.evidence: Node count increases by about 1.63 million after repeated traversal; summaries do not prove detached-node causality, so listener/observer and Detached* retainers require targeted analysis.
findings.suggestedFix: Instrument listeners/timers and compare constructor-level retained objects in same-session snapshots.
